responsibility: This file owns builtin-function support inside libgccjit. It scans GCC’s generated builtins.def metadata, resolves builtin names and IDs, lazily constructs recording::function and recording::function_type objects for supported builtins, maps builtin signature enums onto libgccjit recording types, and synthesizes tree-form builtin attribute lists from builtin-attrs.def for playback-time DECL construction. It is the module’s bridge between GCC’s builtin tables and the JIT recording/playback layers, including caching and the small set of optimization-required builtins that must exist before passes run.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-builtins.h, which declares builtin enums and the builtins_manager interface, this same-stem .c file contains the executable builtin support logic: scanning GCC builtin tables, resolving names and IDs, lazily creating cached recording builtins, mapping builtin type signatures to JIT types, and synthesizing playback-time attribute trees.
